battle.name: 突厥攻擾晉陽之戰
battle.brief: 大業十三年（617）冬，劉武周與劉文靜謀反，遣使結東突厥，引精騎與郡兵進攻晉陽。突厥騎兵擾掠城郊而不能拔城，隋太原留守李淵遣騎出擊，相持數日，突厥引去，晉陽得全。卡面希臘重步兵出自公元前五世紀的方陣戰法，借它標示重步兵以裝備換集體生存的傳統，與突厥輕騎的機動作戰成對照。

kit.name: 希臘重步兵
kit.history: 方陣的重心不是個人，是互相遮蔽。盾牌接在一起時，一支軍隊的正面比一個人結實。

countries: 大業十三年（617）冬，交戰的一方是隋朝的太原防軍與郡兵。太原古稱晉陽，自北齊以來即為北方重鎮，隋廷設太原留守總督軍民事，李淵於大業十三年春到任，倚重城防與募兵整軍；守軍以郡兵、縣兵為骨幹，夾雜北軍與鎮兵，城中備弓弩、鎗、盾與攻城器械，另有精騎巡邏塞外。另一方是劉武周與劉文靜、張寶相等太原郡兵首領結成的叛軍，與東突厥可汗部的聯軍。劉武周原為隋軍行軍總管出身，屢次北伐高句麗，熟悉邊地兵事；起兵後自稱漢王，以晉陽與馬邑為進取關中之資，並遣使與突厥可汗結為兄弟，約以精騎相助。突厥方面，自始畢可汗死後，由其弟處羅可汗與頗利可汗分掌權柄，遣出的騎兵名義上隨劉武周出戰，實際只求掠奪與牽制，並不打算為一個漢王守城，聯盟從一開始就鬆散。兩造在晉陽城下的關係，並非國家之間的正規戰爭，而是隋朝邊軍、地方叛軍與草原騎兵三方各懷算盤的臨時湊合。
countriesEn: In the winter of 617 CE, the thirteenth year of the Daye era, the two sides were the Taiyuan garrison and levies of the Sui dynasty on one hand, and on the other an alliance between the rebel host led by Liu Wuzhou with Liu Wenjing and Zhang Baoxiang, the commanders of the Taiyuan commandery, and the Eastern Turks. Taiyuan, the ancient Jinyang, had been the great fortress of the north since the Northern Qi; the Sui court kept a Taiyuan liushou to command its military and civil affairs, and Li Yuan took up that post in the spring of 617, relying on the city walls and on recruiting to reorganise his command. The garrison was built on commandery and county levies, mixed with regional troops, and the city held crossbows, halberds, shields and siege material, with picked cavalry patrolling the pasture outside the walls. Liu Wuzhou had risen as a marching commander in Sui campaigns against Goguryeo and knew frontier campaigning intimately; after his revolt he proclaimed himself King of Han, treating Jinyang and Mayi as the springboard for a bid at Guanzhong, and he sent envoys to the Turkic khagan, became his sworn brother, and secured the promise of picked cavalry in support. On the Turkic side, after the death of Shebi Khagan, authority was shared by his brothers Chuluo and Jieli; the horsemen they sent out rode under Liu Wuzhou's banner on the field but only wanted plunder and containment, and had no intention of holding a walled city for a Han king, so the alliance was loose from the start. What met outside Jinyang was therefore not a regular war between states, but a temporary conjunction of a Sui frontier garrison, a local rebellion and grassland horsemen, each with its own arithmetic.
people: 劉武周是本次衝突的主角。他是隋末河東一方武裝的首領，出身行伍，曾在隋朝三度征高句麗時擔任行軍總管，熟稔行軍、攻城與騎射諸事，早有割據之志；與劉文靜交厚，兩人商定取太原、馬邑為進圖關中的根基。劉文靜時任太原郡丞，讀過李靖一系流傳的商山之書，深曉兵法，是主張並實際推動通突厥、結外援的人；其後他舉薦李世民出仕，又因傾軋李建成、李元吉而被殺，結局與這場攻擾密切相關。李淵是防守方的統帥，隋廷任以太原留守，他到任後整頓城防、招集軍士，又在隋煬帝大業十三年自涿郡還、途經晉陽時承擔接待與守衛的雙重責任；次年他以晉陽為基地起兵，建立唐朝。劉武周麾下另有張寶相掌兵權，宋金剛驍勇善騎射，所率精兵萬餘皆選於善射者，後來正是這支部隊在雀鼠谷與柏壁被李世民擊潰；尉遲敬德則在武德二年冬於介休歸唐，成為唐軍收拾舊部的關鍵人物。突厥一方的決策者是處羅可汗與頗利可汗兄弟，義成公主居於汗庭，是隋與突厥之間既有的聯繫節點。史載有限，上述數人在此役中的具體部署多不可考，諸說並存。
peopleEn: Liu Wuzhou is the central figure of the episode. A warlord of the Hedong region in the last years of the Sui, he came out of the ranks and had served as a marching commander through the Sui dynasty's three campaigns against Goguryeo, learning movement, siege and mounted archery thoroughly, and had long harboured ambitions of his own. He was close to Liu Wenjing, and the two of them settled on Jinyang and Mayi as the base for a bid at Guanzhong. Liu Wenjing, then commandant of Taiyuan, had read the Shangshan military text handed down in the line of Li Jing and understood strategy well; he was the man who proposed and actually carried out the approach to the Turks and the search for outside support. He later recommended Li Shimin to Li Yuan, and was killed after turning against Li Jiancheng and Li Yuanji, an end closely tied to this affair. Li Yuan commanded the defence. The Sui court made him Taiyuan liushou; he reorganised the city's defences, recruited soldiers, and, when the Sui emperor Yangdi came back from Zhuojun and passed through Jinyang in 617, bore the double duty of receiving and guarding the sovereign. The following year he raised troops at Jinyang and founded the Tang. On the rebel side Zhang Baoxiang held the military command, while Song Jin'gang, dashing and skilled with the bow on horseback, led a picked force of more than ten thousand, every man chosen for his shooting; that force was destroyed by Li Shimin at Queshugu and Boyi. Wei Chi Chiedao surrendered at Jiexiu in the winter of the second year of Wude and became the key to the Tang recovery of the old rebel zone. The decision on the Turkic side lay with the brothers Chuluo and Jieli Khan, with Princess Yicheng resident at the khagan's court as an existing channel between the Sui and the Turks. The records are thin, and the exact deployment of these men in this battle cannot be reconstructed; several versions coexist.
kits: 卡面是一件一千一百餘年前已在歐洲退場的兵器體系：希臘重步兵（Hoplite），約公元前五百年定型於希臘城邦，正面是一列持大圓盾與長矛的密集方陣，士卒披胸甲、戴科林斯式頭盔、著護脛，全套裝備須自備，徵召自能負擔的農戶。Hoplite一詞的本義就是持盾者，其戰爭邏輯是以裝備的重量換取集體的生存，方陣的正面因盾牌相接而變得比任何單兵都結實。但這套東西與617年的晉陽城下毫無關係，本役真正作戰的是隋唐式的步兵與東突厥的輕騎。隋軍步卒用長槊、矛、鎗刀與弓箭，鎧以皮甲、札甲為主，靠長槍如林的縱列與結陣自守；攻城與守城則靠雲梯、巢車、撞車與床子弩。突厥精騎用角弓與筋角複合弓、標槍、彎刀，披輕便的皮毛防護，鞍韁齊備，載重小、機動快，卻不帶任何攻城器械；攻城器物的缺席，正是他們只能攻擾而不能攻取晉陽的技術原因。若要為這場戰爭找一件對照的兵器，重步兵方陣正好是反面的一極：它站得穩卻走不動，靠正面硬頂換推進；而晉陽城下的較量，恰恰是誰能在攻防的間隙裡跑得比對方更快。
kitsEn: The card shows a weapon system that had left Europe more than eleven centuries earlier: the Greek hoplite, a type fixed around 500 BCE in the Greek city-states. Its front rank was a dense phalanx of large round shields (aspis) and long spears (dory); the men wore bronze cuirasses, Corinthian helmets and greaves, supplied their own full kit, and were drawn from among the peasants who could bear its weight. The word hoplite simply means shield-bearer; its logic of war is to trade the weight of equipment for collective survival, the front of the phalanx made tougher than any single man by shields locked side by side. None of that has anything to do with Jinyang in 617. What actually fought here was Sui-Tang style foot and the light cavalry of the Eastern Turks. Sui foot carried long spears, halberds and sabres, used bows and crossbows, and wore leather and lamellar armour, standing in ordered ranks where the spear forest met the shield wall; siege and defence work rested on scaling ladders, siege towers, battering rams and heavy crossbows. Turkic light horse used composite bows of horn and sinew, javelins and curved sabres, wore light leather and fur protection, and had saddle and rein complete: little carried, fast moved, and no siege engine whatsoever. That absence of siege equipment is exactly why they could harass Jinyang but never take it. If the card is to be matched with a weapon for this battle, the hoplite phalanx is the polar opposite: it stands firm and cannot move, winning by pushing the front forward, while the contest below Jinyang was decided by who could move faster than the other in the gap between assault and defence.
tactics: 整場衝突可分三段。第一段是突厥騎手的接近：數千騎分成數隊沿汾水與太原盆地邊緣展開，不急於攻城，而是以弓矢覆蓋城郊，逼近城下的隋軍步卒迫其離城野戰，同時切斷由北面與西北面通往馬邑的糧道與驛路，用騎兵速度把消息與援軍擋在城外。第二段是攻城嘗試：劉武周以本部郡兵列陣於城北，試圖以雲梯與穴地接近城牆，但缺乏攻城器械與步騎配合，隋方弓弩居高臨下，攻勢很快僵持成相持；數日之後，突厥方面判斷晉陽城防堅固，而自身既無攻城手段又遠離基地，遂帶走掠得的牲畜與糧秣引兵而去，劉武周未能入城。第三段是反擊與追擊的邏輯：本役本身沒有大規模反攻，但此後兩年李世民收復太原所用的辦法，正是針對這套騎兵戰術而來——據城深壁、斷其糧道、以關中與晉陽之間的正面穩住對手，待其師老兵疲，再以精騎在雀鼠谷狹道中追擊散兵。無論是617年的攻擾還是619年之後的收復，勝負關鍵始終是同一件事：能不能在對方騎兵來去自如之前，把自己的步兵與城牆綁在一起。
tacticsEn: The episode can be read in three movements. First, the approach of the Turkic riders: several thousand horsemen spread out in bands along the Fen River and the rim of the Taiyuan basin, in no hurry to assault, but covering the ground outside the walls with arrows, forcing Sui foot out of the city into open battle, and cutting the grain road and the post road that ran north and north-west toward Mayi, using their speed to hold back messages and reinforcements. Second, the attempt on the walls: Liu Wuzhou drew up his commandery levies north of the city and tried to work forward with scaling ladders and approaches, but without siege material and without coordination between foot and horse, while Sui crossbows fired from above; the assault soon stiffened into a stalemate. After several days the Turkic side judged the walls of Jinyang too strong and, having neither siege means nor a nearby base, took its plundered livestock and grain and withdrew; Liu Wuzhou did not enter the city. Third, the logic of counter-stroke and pursuit: this battle itself saw no large-scale counter-offensive, but the method Li Shimin used two years later to recover Taiyuan was built precisely against this style of mounted warfare, digging in at a strong city, cutting the enemy's supply line, holding the front between Guanzhong and Jinyang, letting the opponent tire, and then chasing the broken columns with picked cavalry in the narrow Queshugu valley. Whether in the harassment of 617 or in the recovery after 619, the question was always the same: can your infantry and your walls be bound together before the enemy cavalry gets the freedom of the field.
data: 本役留下的數字不多，須逐一分辨。時間上，主流記載把劉武周起兵與突厥來犯繫於隋大業十三年（617）冬，即十一月至十二月之間；此役距雁門之圍（615）約兩年，彼時始畢可汗曾率數十萬騎圍雁門，隋煬帝受困月餘，可見突厥在隋末北方仍有壓倒性的騎兵優勢。地理上，晉陽（太原）距長安直線約九百餘公里，至洛陽約五百多公里，屬關中防禦最外一圈；地勢上，太原盆地東倚太行八陘，北面敞向雲中、馬邑，騎兵可直抵城下，而城西南汾水一線是守軍唯一能反擊的地形。兵員方面，劉武周所部為太原、馬邑一帶徵集的郡兵，兵數史無明文，諸說在數千至數萬之間；同來的只有精騎數千的概數，具體編制不詳。防守方同樣沒有大軍，太原一城在招募後可倚賴的兵員約數萬人，其餘靠城垣、堡柵與弓弩支撐。相持時間，史料只說數日或十餘日，兩說並存。往後的數字較為可靠：劉武周於武德二年（619）再攻，終於攻陷太原與並州、介州，兵力直抵雀鼠谷、柏壁；李世民據堅壁與之相持數月，終於大破宋金剛部，劉武周放棄太原北走突厥，同年死於突厥之手。距離、口徑與兵力的量級，大致就是這場戰爭全部可用的數字。
dataEn: Few figures survive for this engagement, and each has to be sorted out. In time, most accounts tie Liu Wuzhou's revolt and the Turkic incursion to the winter of the thirteenth year of Daye (617), between the eleventh and twelfth months; the episode came about two years after the siege of Yanmen (615), when Shebi Khagan had ringed Yanmen with tens of thousands of riders and held the Sui emperor for a month or more, showing that the Turks still held an overwhelming advantage in horsemen in the late Sui north. Geographically, Jinyang (Taiyuan) lies a little over nine hundred kilometres from Chang'an in a straight line and some five hundred and fifty from Luoyang, the outermost ring of the Guanzhong defence. In terrain, the Taiyuan basin leans on the Taihang passes to the east and opens north to Yunzhong and Mayi, where cavalry could ride right up to the walls, while the Fen River line to the south-west is the only ground on which the defenders could strike back. On numbers: Liu Wuzhou's men were commandery levies recruited around Taiyuan and Mayi, and no count is recorded, estimates ranging from a few thousand to tens of thousands; the cavalry that came with him is given only as picked horse in the thousands, with no establishment set out. The defence had no field army either: the strength behind Taiyuan's walls after recruiting was of the order of tens of thousands, and the rest of the garrison rested on walls, stockades and crossbows. The time of the stalemate is given only as several days or more than ten days, two versions that coexist. Later figures are firmer: in the second year of Wude (619) Liu Wuzhou attacked again and this time took Taiyuan, Bingzhou and Jiezhou, driving on to Queshugu and Boyi; Li Shimin held his strong positions for months and finally destroyed Song Jin'gang's army, and Liu Wuzhou abandoned Taiyuan and fled north to the Turks, dying there in the same year. Distance, scale and strength: that is essentially the whole of the numbers this battle leaves behind.
cause: 打起來的原因有三層。最外層是隋朝崩解的整體環境：大業七至十三年三次征高句麗耗盡府庫，徭役與兵役攤到河東、馬邑邊地，馬政與轉運的負擔最重；地方郡兵屢次被抽調離鄉，邊防空虛。就在同一年，隋煬帝自涿郡還，途經晉陽逗留數月才南下江都，北方軍政的重心一度集中於此，而煬帝本人與中央朝廷的權威已遠離北方。中層是劉武周本人的算計：他熟悉邊地兵事，看出太原與馬邑兩處的價值，一處是關中屏藩，一處是草原通道，兼得便可進圖關中；他與劉文靜商定起事時便明白，單憑郡兵不足以對抗關中兵團，必須借突厥的騎兵，所以先遣使通好、與可汗結為兄弟，把外兵變成第一步棋。內層是突厥自身的轉移：始畢可汗死後，汗位由其弟處羅可汗與頗利可汗分掌，義成公主居於汗庭，突厥對隋的策略本就是邊打邊談、趁中原內亂索取利益；劉武周送上這份邀請，正中其下懷。於是三方各懷算盤，在晉陽城下短兵相接。
causeEn: There are three layers of cause. The outermost is the general collapse of the Sui: the three campaigns against Goguryeo between 607 and 613 drained the treasury, and the labour and conscription levies fell hardest on Hedong and the Mayi frontier, where the burden of horses and transport was heaviest; the commandery levies of the area were repeatedly drawn away and the border was left hollow. In that same year the Sui emperor Yangdi came back from Zhuojun, lingered at Jinyang for several months and only then went south to Jiangdu, so that the centre of northern military administration sat for a time at this one city, while the emperor and the court had already moved far from the north. The middle layer is Liu Wuzhou's own calculation. He knew frontier warfare and read the value of the two places, one the screen of Guanzhong, the other the corridor of the steppe; holding both would open the road to Guanzhong. Planning his revolt with Liu Wenjing, he understood that commandery levies alone could not stand against the armies of Guanzhong and that Turkic cavalry had to be borrowed, so he sent envoys first, became the khagan's sworn brother, and turned foreign troops into his first move. The innermost layer is the shift inside the steppe: after Shebi Khagan died, authority was shared by his brothers Chuluo and Jieli, with Princess Yicheng resident at the khagan's court, and Turkic policy toward the Sui was always to fight and negotiate at once and to profit from the disorder in the central plains. Liu Wuzhou's invitation came as a gift. Three parties, each with its own arithmetic, met in a short, sharp fight below Jinyang.
impact: 直接結果是晉陽沒有淪陷，隋朝北方最後一個像樣的重鎮被保住了，但這只是表面上的輸贏。劉武周並未因此罷手，反而由此證明他借突厥騎兵取城的路子可行，只是時機未到；兩年後當隋廷崩潰、李淵與李世民尚在關中爭奪天下時，他果然再攻得手，攻陷太原、並州、介州，把兵鋒推到雀鼠谷、柏壁，關中震動。攻擾把他的戰略推到最高點，也把他送上絕路：李世民據晉陽而西，以深壁斷糧的辦法專打騎兵的補給線，柏壁一戰宋金剛部覆滅，劉武周棄太原北走突厥，並在同年死於頗利可汗之手。從更長的視角看，這一役是隋末北方崩解的節點：它證明草原騎兵可以深入關中的門戶，也證明關中一旦握有城牆與充足兵員，騎兵就無法攻取。往後唐對突厥的取向因此兩度反轉，先以騎兵收復失地，再以騎兵奇襲定襄，至貞觀四年（630）滅東突厥。卡面那副希臘重步兵方陣在這條長線上的位置也清楚了：一千一百年前靠密集盾牆取勝的步兵，到617年已被史書記作兵貴結陣的傳統，而真正左右戰局的，換成了馬力、弓弦與糧道。
impactEn: The immediate effect was that Jinyang did not fall and the last respectable stronghold in the Sui north was preserved, but that was only the surface result. Liu Wuzhou did not stop there; the episode instead demonstrated that the Turkic cavalry could indeed carry a rebel to the walls of a capital region, and that the opportunity was only a matter of timing. Two years later, when the Sui had dissolved and Li Yuan and Li Shimin were still contending for the realm in Guanzhong, he attacked again and this time succeeded, taking Taiyuan, Bingzhou and Jiezhou and pushing his spearhead to Queshugu and Boyi, which shook Guanzhong. The harassment carried Liu Wuzhou's strategy to its height and also to his ruin: Li Shimin, holding Jinyang and pressing west while cutting the supply line, attacked exactly what mounted warfare depended on, and the army of Song Jin'gang was destroyed at Boyi; Liu Wuzhou abandoned Taiyuan, fled north to the Turks, and was killed the same year on the khagan's orders. In the longer view, the episode marks the point where the northern order came apart: it proved that grassland horse could ride to the gateway of Guanzhong, and equally that once Guanzhong held walls and men in sufficient number, horse could not take them. Tang policy toward the Turks reversed twice accordingly, first with cavalry to recover the lost ground, then with a night raid on Dingxiang and the destruction of the Eastern Turks in 630. The place of the hoplite card in that long line is now clear too: the infantry victory that rested on a locked shield wall eleven centuries earlier survived in the historical record as the doctrine of forming ranks, while what actually decided battles had shifted to horseflesh, bowstring and supply line.
result: 就本役本身而言，結果是突厥沒有攻下晉陽。劉武周引來的突厥精騎在城郊擾亂數日，攻城不成，遂帶走掠得的牲畜與糧秣引去，兩軍各自退去，劉武周仍以太原、馬邑一帶的郡兵與突厥維持盟約。防守一方贏得的只是一段喘息的時間：隋廷的崩解已不可挽回，兩年後劉武周再來時，晉陽因內部的權力真空而陷落。最後的結局在武德二年（619）末至武德三年（620）初決定：劉武周軍在介休、雀鼠谷至柏壁一線被李世民的唐軍擊破，太原重歸唐朝，劉武周北走突厥，最終為頗利可汗所忌而遭殺害，部眾與家屬則被徙入漠北安置。東突厥本身並未受損，控弦之眾仍在漠北，與唐朝對峙近半個世紀，終於貞觀四年被李靖一軍夜襲定襄而亡國。從大歷史看，晉陽保住了唐代真正的發源地，馬邑、太原、關中這條線也從此寫進中原王朝對付草原的兵學裡。
resultEn: As for the battle itself, the result was that the Turks did not take Jinyang. The picked Turkic horsemen Liu Wuzhou had brought disturbed the ground below the walls for several days, failed to carry the assault, and then took their plundered livestock and grain away with them; the two sides withdrew, and Liu Wuzhou maintained his alliance with the Turks on the strength of his Taiyuan and Mayi levies. What the defence won was only a respite: the collapse of the Sui could no longer be prevented, and two years later, when the internal power vacuum left Jinyang open, Liu Wuzhou took it. The final settlement was decided between the end of 619 and the beginning of 620: Liu Wuzhou's army was broken by Li Shimin's Tang forces along the line from Jiexiu through Queshugu to Boyi, Taiyuan returned to Tang hands, Liu Wuzhou fled north to the Turks and was eventually killed on the orders of Jieli Khagan, his followers and kin being resettled in the northern steppe. The Eastern Turks themselves were not damaged and still held their bowmen in the steppe, facing the Tang for close to half a century, until a night strike on Dingxiang by Li Jing destroyed their state in 630. In the greater history, Jinyang preserved the true birthplace of the Tang, and the line running Mayi, Taiyuan and Guanzhong was written into the military thinking of the central plains against the steppe.
